subject: Some genes have no counts (empty) in featurecounts table

messages.author: 301a8f8d82f1dbc5
messages.subject: Some genes have no counts (empty) in featurecounts table
parts:
Hi Prof. Shi,
I got a issue that some transposon expressions were reported with empty counts (no counts), see sheet1 in the enclosed file, when I used featurecounts to count the reads. Here is my code:

featureCounts -T 24 -t exon -g gene_id -a /mm10_UCSC_rmsk_190619.gtf -o ./fast/PIWIsc.TE/count/TE_GeneLevel_counts.txt /fast/PIWIsc.TE/bam.align/*.bam

The version of featureCounts is v1.6.0. There is no error massage.
I noticed that transposons (like genes) with empty counts have more than 6552 exons, see the number of chr in sheet2 in enclosed file. Is there a limit in the number of exons that featureCounts would count? How can I overcome this issue? 
I downloaded .gtf file generated by repeatmasker from UCSC. 

Best,
Mingxing Yang

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Some genes have no counts (empty) in featurecounts table
parts:
I can see from Sheet 1 that you got counts for most genes. When you say transposons have zero counts, where are these transposons in the sheet? Have you looked at the mapping results using for example IGB to see if there are any reads mapping to those transposons? 

featureCounts has no limitation on the number of exons a gene can have.
